whatsNew.summary: Watch a glasses meeting as it happens. While a meeting records on your G2, Meetings shows a Live now row with the transcript streaming in, and Copy transcript copies everything said so far.

sections.title: Live meeting transcript
items: While a meeting records on your glasses, a Live now row sits at the top of Meetings with a red dot.
Open it to watch the transcript arrive, a few seconds behind the conversation. It follows the newest line until you scroll up, and Jump to live brings you back.
Copy transcript copies everything so far, one line per speaker turn with its time.
The live text is preliminary. When you save the meeting, the saved version opens in its place, and its text can change as it is finalized.
Speaker names are voice matches, not certainties. A voice nobody has named shows as Speaker.
The transcript only opens when you click it. Turn it off in Settings with Show live meeting transcript.

sections.title: From 0.5.277
items: The version card is gone. The refresh button at the top right also checks for updates, and the version shows next to Control.
